title: CanonicalUuid
description: The canonical wire representation of every UUID-backed newtype's ToJSON instance (deriving newtype from Data.UUID, Arkham/Id.hs -- e.g. LocationId, PlayerId): lowercase, hyphenated, 8-4-4-4-12 hex. Rejects uppercase spelling even though format:uuid alone would accept the same UUID value. Extracted so every governed schema that embeds a raw UUID string shares one canonical pattern instead of duplicating it.
